fdroid:com.stoutner.privacycell.name: Privacy Cell
fdroid:com.stoutner.privacycell.summary: Verify that a phone is using the most secure cell protocols.
fdroid:com.stoutner.privacycell.description:
Privacy Cell is a small app that displays the cell phone protocol information.
At the time of this writing, many cell phone networks are switching from 4G (4th Generation) to 5G networks. The 5G network protocols were specifically designed to protect against some of the known insecurities of the older protocols, including those that allowed stingrays (IMSI catchers) to perform man-in-the-middle attacks on cell phone networks. To ease deployment and backwards compatibility, 4G and 5G networks can run together in what is known as 5G NR (New Radio) NSA (Non-Standalone) mode. This uses the 4G network for the control channel and the 5G network for the data communication. However, 5G NR NSA does not provide protection against stingrays. Android has access to all the information it needs to know if it is connected to a 5G NR NSA or a 5G NR SA (Standalone) network, but it doesn’t display that information to the user. The purpose of Privacy Cell is to make that information easy to access.
Privacy Cell can also warn you when you are connected to antiquated 2G and 3G networks.

Stay in control of your conversations with Call Limiter — lightweight, private, and designed to fit seamlessly into your daily calling habits.

fdroid:de.singular.looper.name: Rubber Ring
fdroid:de.singular.looper.summary: A looper for practicing song parts.
fdroid:de.singular.looper.description:
Rubber Ring is a tool for practicing song parts. Pick an audio file, mark a start/stop region on its waveform, and play it back in a seamless, gapless loop. It auto-detects tempo and beats to snap the loop markers to a beat grid, with full manual override.
Early-stage release — expect rough edges. Feedback and bug reports welcome via Issues.
Features:
* Import-and-own library — picked files are copied into app-private storage, so loops never break when the original is moved, renamed, or deleted.
* Library with search, sorting and stars — pull the list down to find a track by name, sort by recently used, name, length or date added, and star favourites to keep them at the top.
* Waveform region selection with gapless looping — drag start/stop handles to mark a section; the loop boundary wraps with zero audible gap or click.
* Automatic, hand-editable beat grid — a dependency-free estimator finds BPM and a downbeat, and handles snap to the beat grid.
* Chord detection with a hand-editable chord lane — chords are labelled over the waveform; tap to relabel, split or merge. Detection is tuned to the author's own material, so the lane is there to correct by hand, and can be turned off.
* Per-track audio normalization — boost a track that was mixed too quietly, by peak or by loudness; your original file is never altered.
* Adjustable playback speed — slow a tricky passage down (or speed it up) without changing pitch.
* Count-in — long-press Play to start after a metronome counts you in at the track's tempo.
* Saved loops and practice arrangements — capture named sections per track and chain them into a sequence, each repeated as many times as you set.
* Export a saved loop as a WAV file, at the current speed, for a DAW or to share.
* Backup & restore — export your whole library to a file and restore it after a reinstall.
* English and German, with optional German note names (H and B) for chords.
* Opens audio shared from other apps.
No ads, no trackers, no network access.

fedora-packages:driverctl/driverctl.name: driverctl
fedora-packages:driverctl/driverctl.description: driverctl is a tool for manipulating and inspecting the system device driver choices. Devices are normally assigned to their sole designated kernel driver by default. However in some situations it may be desireable to override that default, for example to try an older driver to work around a regression in a driver or to try an experimental alternative driver. Another common use-case is pass-through drivers and driver stubs to allow userspace to drive the device, such as in case of virtualization. driverctl integrates with udev to support overriding driver selection for both cold- and hotplugged devices from the moment of discovery, but can also change already assigned drivers, assuming they are not in use by the system. The driver overrides created by driverctl are persistent across system reboots by default.

firefox-addons:3072684.summary: Video Downloader VeeVee – download videos from the Internet. Detect media on supported websites, preview available files, choose the preferred quality, and save videos or audio directly to your device.
firefox-addons:3072684.description:
One of the most popular video saving tools for browsers.
VeeVee allows you to save videos in SD, HD, Full HD, 2K, and 4K formats from many popular video sites. It is simple, fast, and safe to use.
Add the extension to your browser in just one minute. Then click the extension icon on the target website and start saving your videos.
 Features 
 Save videos from supported website
 Retrieve HTML5 videos from almost any site
 High-quality saving options: 720p, 1080p, 2K, and 4K
 HLS stream support: detect M3U8 files, load TS segments, combine into MP4
 No registration required; completely free to use
 Built-in video preview player
 Copy media links to share with friends
 Play MP4 files on Chromecast or Google Home
 Scan QR codes to watch and save videos directly to your phone
 Batch download — select videos or audios to process
 Search by title, quality, type, and file size
 Light / dark theme
 Important 
VeeVee is a tool for saving and managing videos. It is designed to work only with legal, publicly accessible content. The extension does not provide access to copyrighted, premium, or restricted material and does not bypass DRM, paywalls, protected streams, or any technical protection measures.
VeeVee provides access solely to saving tools. It does not grant access to any content that the user does not already have lawful access to. Users are fully responsible for ensuring that any videos they save comply with copyright and intellectual property laws, as well as the terms of the websites they visit.
In accordance with US DMCA and EU copyright directives, VeeVee operates as a neutral technical tool and processes only the media that is already available to the user. VeeVee is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with any third-party video hosting platforms or content providers.
Some websites may restrict saving due to their own policies. In certain cases, you may need to start playing the video so the extension can detect it. A new browser tab may open to process and save the file — this is expected behavior.
 How VeeVee Handles Website Data 
To detect downloadable media, VeeVee analyzes relevant page content and network requests on websites you visit.
For TikTok, Instagram, and X / Twitter, service-specific processing begins only after you provide permission through the extension’s consent window.
For TikTok, the video URL may be sent to third-party video-processing services, including tikwm.com and tiktokjs-downloader.vercel.app, solely to obtain video information and download links.
For Instagram and X / Twitter, the extension may use your current session data, such as cookies or service tokens, to request video information from those platforms or their embedded-content services.
This information is processed only to provide VeeVee’s video detection and saving features. VeeVee does not sell user data or use it for advertising. Additional details are available in our Privacy Policy.
 Copyright Holders 
If you believe that content available through VeeVee infringes your copyright, please contact us at info@veevee.app with your organization name, contact information, and proof of exclusive rights. Only the copyright owner or an authorized representative may submit a claim. We regularly review and exclude websites containing copyrighted or restricted content.
 Support 
If you encounter issues or videos that cannot be saved, please email us instead of leaving a negative rating. Help us improve the extension: info@veevee.app
 Privacy Policy 
VeeVee does not require registration and does not ask users to provide their name, email address, payment information, or other profile information.
To provide its video detection and saving features, the extension processes limited website and browsing data as described above. This may include page content, media URLs, network request information, service-specific session data, extension settings, and consent preferences.
Some information is processed locally in the browser. When required to provide a requested feature, limited information may be transmitted to the relevant website or disclosed third-party processing services.
VeeVee does not sell user data or use it for advertising, profiling, credit decisions, or purposes unrelated to the extension’s video-saving functionality.
Privacy Policy — https://veevee.app/privacy-policy 
Terms and Conditions — https://veevee.app/terms 
If you do not agree with our Privacy Policy, please remove the extension.

apple-itunes:484829437.description:
Say goodbye to all the calendars and schedule planner apps you’ve ever used on your iPhone or iPad, as Awesome Calendar is going to change the game. This perfect time management app delivers everything you should expect from such planner apps and it even sets the bar to a higher level by offering fresh and intuitive user interface, ultimate customization options, detailed weather forecast, tons of emoji stickers to add to the calendar view and a lot more. 
With Awesome Calendar, you’ll have access to a multi-functional task manager app to organize your life. This personal planner app comes with a clean and neat design and the interface is so user-friendly that you’ll get the whole idea after browsing through the menus for a few times. You get to easily add a note, create an event or set a reminder right from calendar’s month view. To switch between different views (Week or Day view) you just need to double tap on the screen and to see available events for a specific day, you just need to tap on that date (a pop-up opens). 
So, if you care about being organized and want to never be worried about forgetting a meeting, missing a deadline or forgetting the long lists of your to-dos, then the Awesome Calendar is A Must Have App for you.
Download this calendar and planner app and start adding your agenda, to-do lists and your upcoming events to it. Awesome Calendar will automatically organize everything and will let you know as soon as there is a deadline, a meeting or an event to attend to.
Why Should I Install Awesome Calendar on my iPhone?
While there are so many calendar apps to download and use, including the default iPhone’s calendar app, why should I trust this planner pro app and use it as my organizer app? Well, this is a fair question to ask and here are just a few reasons for installing this wonderful app:
One. It’s extremely easy to use. This awesome app packs all the great features in a very well designed interface and you can easily track your events in different views.
Two. It syncs with all iPhone calendar apps. If you are already using old-fashioned calendar apps, you can easily bring all your data to this awesome app.
Three. It offers ultimate customization options. You get to easily set custom color for event and reminder, and change the font size and style in the notes and different views. There is also the option to add stickers to the month view.
Four. Detailed weather forecast. There is built-in weather app in the Awesome Calendar which helps you track the weather condition before deciding where to go and when to go. 
And there are tons of other great features waiting for you…
Awesome Calendar & Personal Planner Main Features at a Glance:
+ Natural Language Input
+ Clean and neat design with super user-friendly interface
+ Easy to navigate through different views and adding new tasks, to-dos or events
+ Syncs with all iPhone calendars
+ Ultimate customization options (change Color, Font, Style and more)
+ Holiday listings for 35 different countries
+ Month, week agenda, half-week, day and list views
+ Powerful search tool to look through your events, notes and to-dos
+ Current weather condition + 5-day weather forecast
+ Wide range of emoji stickers to be used in the month view
+ Add photos to your notes
+ Create recurring events (upgrade to full version)
+ Set priority and reminders for your events
+ Check your schedule at a glance in month view
+ No ads (upgrade to full version)
So, Awesome Calendar is here to organize your life and make sure you never miss an important date or a meeting. You just need to add all your tasks, events, and meetings to the app, and leave the rest to this awesome scheduler app. You get to easily create custom alarms and reminders for any event and be notified of your upcoming event. The weather forecast feature, helps you schedule your day easier and more efficient.

The web should work for you.
Blank Browser is a modern web browser built for people who value speed, privacy, and control without sacrificing the browsing experience they expect. Whether you’re reading the news, shopping online, researching a topic, or managing your daily workflow, Blank Browser gives you the tools to browse the way you want.
Choose between Standard Browsing and Private Browsing at any time. Standard Browsing saves your history, cookies, passwords, and website preferences for a familiar experience. Private Browsing uses an isolated browsing session that leaves no lasting website data behind when you’re finished. Switching between modes is quick and seamless.
Take control of online distractions with a powerful built-in content blocker. Block ads, trackers, unwanted domains, and other web content to create a cleaner browsing experience. Import public filter lists, create your own blocklists and whitelists, build wildcard or regular expression rules, and customize exactly how websites behave. Your browsing experience is yours to control.
Blank Browser also helps you better understand the websites you visit. View detailed page information including SSL certificate details, cookies, downloads, permissions, connection information, observed technologies, and other useful insights. Everything is presented in a clear and accessible way, making advanced information available without requiring technical expertise.
Your passwords remain protected with the built-in Password Manager. Credentials are securely stored using Apple’s Keychain, with an optional PIN available for an additional layer of protection before viewing or editing saved logins.
Additional features include:
• Built-in ad and tracker blocking
• Custom blocklists and whitelists
• Import public filter lists
• Regular expression and wildcard filtering
• Per-site permissions
• Popup blocking
• Mobile and desktop website switching
• Download manager
• Favorites manager
• Detailed page information
• Browsing statistics
• Modern tab management
• Password Manager with optional PIN protection
• Support for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
Unlike many browsers, Blank Browser does not require you to create an account before you can browse the web. There are no mandatory sign-ins or unnecessary barriers between you and the internet.
Blank Browser is actively developed with regular updates focused on website compatibility, browsing performance, stability, privacy improvements, and new features. Every update is designed to make browsing faster, more reliable, and more enjoyable while keeping you in control of your experience.

apple-itunes:1035689743.name: BusyCal: Calendar & Tasks
apple-itunes:1035689743.description:
BusyCal is a calendar and task planner built for busy schedules. It connects to every account you already use, shows your events and tasks side by side, and bends to the way you work: pinch to see more days or weeks, type events the way you would say them, and keep everything in sync with BusyCal for Mac.
One-time purchase. No subscription.
YOUR CALENDAR, YOUR WAY
• Day, Week, Month, Year and List views, plus a dedicated Task list
• Pinch to zoom: 2 to 14 days per week and 2 to 8 weeks per month, with separate portrait and landscape layouts
• Customize colors, text size, weekend shading, week numbers and working hours, or show a Chinese, Hebrew, Islamic or Japanese calendar alongside
• Year view as a wall planner or heat map, with Highlights that reveal your busiest months, top calendars and meeting stats
TYPE IT THE WAY YOU WOULD SAY IT
• Type "Lunch with Sam next Tuesday at noon" or "Standup every weekday at 9:30" and BusyCal fills in the date, time and repeat as you type
• Understands alarms, time zones, calendars (/work) and links, in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese
TASKS IN YOUR CALENDAR
• Dated, timed and undated tasks appear right in your calendar and carry forward until done
• Priorities, repeats, and a Task list you can sort by due date, priority, calendar, tag or by hand
• Works with Apple Reminders, iCloud, Google Tasks, Todoist and Fastmail
EVERY ACCOUNT, ONE APP
• iCloud, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com, Exchange, Yahoo, Fastmail, Fruux and any CalDAV server, plus WebDAV subscriptions for holidays and sports
• Push updates where your server supports them, and accounts you add once are offered to your other devices
• Syncs with BusyCal for Mac, Apple Calendar and any other app on the same accounts
MEETINGS AND INVITES
• Invite attendees, and accept, decline or reply Maybe straight from the Inbox
• Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex and GoTo links become one-tap join buttons, and you can create Zoom and Teams meetings from inside the app
• Block time on a second calendar in a couple of taps, with or without the details
WIDGETS, WATCH, SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
• Home Screen widgets for what is next, your agenda, the week, two weeks, three weeks, and tasks you can complete from the widget
• Lock Screen widgets and Control Center buttons for new events and tasks
• Apple Watch app with calendar, today, up next and tasks views, plus complications for your watch face
• Siri: "Add lunch with Sam tomorrow at noon", "What's coming up", "When am I free"
• Shortcuts actions to find, create, move, defer and complete items, and a Focus filter that switches calendar sets
TRAVEL TIME, MAPS AND TIME ZONES
• Add travel time to an event and get a leave-now alert based on real driving or walking time
• Maps inside event details, with directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze, Citymapper or TomTom GO
• Favorite time zones, and events that start and end in different zones
TAGS, CALENDAR SETS AND PRIVACY
• Color-coded tags to track projects, people and priorities across calendars
• Calendar sets: named groups of calendars, each with its own default calendars and preferred view, synced across your devices
• Lock the app, or just certain calendar sets, with Face ID or Touch ID
AND MORE
• Weather and moon phases on your calendar
• Birthdays and anniversaries from Contacts, with age and years
• Search titles, locations, notes and tags across past and future
BusyCal has been trusted by Mac users for more than a decade. The iPhone and iPad app is its full-featured companion, made by the same team.
